posts.title: Looking for Answers
posts.description: I've been looking for answers. To a question I don't even know the words to. Or have too many words for. Too many questions. What kind of exercise can I commit to? How can I get a job I like? How do I make friends? How do I live on my own? I know the answer to these. posts.title: a small accommodation
posts.description: My bedroom is in the basement with windows at the front of the house. Our street isn't super busy, but there's enough people walking past or delivery people coming to the door and that makes me anxious. posts.title: a good day
posts.description: Today was a good day. I saw my brother, I talked to my sister, and I remembered to take the recycling out. I also ordered groceries and have a therapy appointment tomorrow. Some days are just good days and deserve a moment to just be good.
